title: Create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as phone call
content_data:
This article introduces how to create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as phone call. This enables the ad audience to directly reach out to you (the advertiser) via phone by clicking the call-to-action button within the ad, or be directed to view a Custom TikTok Instant Page. > **Note**
> Creating a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as phone call is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. # Steps ## 1. Create a campaign Create a campaign using [/campaign/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739318962329602). Note that the following requirements must be met. ```xtable | Setting {20%} | Requirement {30%} | Parameter {20%} | How to configure the parameter {30%} | |---|---|---|---| | Advertising objective | Lead Generation | `objective_type` | `LEAD_GENERATION` | | Smart+ Campaign| Disabled

If you are not sure about whether the campaign is Smart+ Campaign, you can use the `is_smart_performance_campaign` field returned from [/campaign/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739315828649986) to check. | / | / | ``` ### Example Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "objective_type": "LEAD_GENERATION", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "budget": {{budget}} }' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "modify_time": "{{modify_time}}", "objective": "LANDING_PAGE", "roas_bid": 0, "budget": {{budget}}, "secondary_status": "CAMPAIGN_STATUS_ENABLE", "is_smart_performance_campaign": false, "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "deep_bid_type": null, "campaign_type": "REGULAR_CAMPAIGN", "is_new_structure": true, "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "objective_type": "LEAD_GENERATION", "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "operation_status": "ENABLE" } } (/code) ``` ## 2. Create an ad group Create an ad group using [/adgroup/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739499616346114). Note that the following requirements must be met. ``` xtable | Setting {20%} | Requirement {22%} | Parameter {28%} | How to configure the parameter {30%} | |---|---|---| | Optimization location
(Promotion type) | Phone call | `promotion_type`
`promotion_target_type`|
  • Set `promotion_type` to `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`,
  • AND do not pass `promotion_target_type`.
| | Placement | Select Placement with TikTok placement| `placement_type`
`placements` |
  • Set `placement_type` to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`
  • AND set `placements` to ` ["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]`.
| | Age targeting | Audiences younger than 18 years old can't be targeted. | `age_groups` | Do not pass the value `AGE_13_17`. | | Demographics - Location targeting | The available targeting regions are as follows:
  • APAC: Australia, Cambodia, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam
  • LATAM: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Mexico, Peru
Note that advertisers registered with the Chinese mainland (`CN`) cannot target locations in Australia and Indonesia. | `location_ids` | Pass the IDs of locations within the following regions:
  • APAC: Australia, Cambodia, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam
  • LATAM: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Mexico, Peru
Note that advertisers registered with the Chinese mainland (`CN`) cannot target locations in Australia and Indonesia.

To obtain the available targeting locations, use [/tool/targeting/search/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1761236883355649) or [/tool/region/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737189539571713). | | Pangle audience packages | Not supported| `included_pangle_audience_package_ids`
`excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids`| Not supported | | Optimization goal | Click | `optimization_goal` | `CLICK` | | Billing event | CPC | `billing_event` | `CPC` | | Search ads| Not supported| `search_result_enabled`| Can only set it to `false`, or do not pass this field.| | Automated Creative Optimization (ACO) | Not supported| `creative_material_mode` |`CUSTOM` or not passed| ``` ### Example Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/adgroup/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "adgroup_name": "{{adgroup_name}}", "promotion_type": "LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL", "placement_type": "PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL", "placements": ["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"], "video_download_disabled": false, "location_ids": ["{{location_id}}"], "gender": "GENDER_UNLIMITED", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "budget":{{budget}}, "schedule_type": "SCHEDULE_START_END", "schedule_start_time": "{{schedule_end_time}}", "schedule_end_time": "{{schedule_end_time}}", "optimization_goal": "CLICK", "bid_type": "BID_TYPE_NO_BID", "billing_event": "CPC", "pacing": "PACING_MODE_SMOOTH" }' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{adgroup_id}}", "purchased_impression": null, "rf_estimated_frequency": null, "skip_learning_phase": false, "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "dayparting": "" } } (/code) ``` ## 3. Create an ad Create an ad using [/ad/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739953377508354). Note that the following requirements must be met. ```xtable | Setting {20%} | Requirement {20%} | Parameter {22%} | How to configure the parameter {38%} | |---|---|---|---| | Ad format | Any of the following types:
  • Single video
  • Carousel images
| `ad_format` | Any of the following values:
  • `SINGLE_VIDEO`
  • `CAROUSEL_ADS`
    • To learn about how to create Standard Carousel Ads, see [Steps for creating Standard Carousel Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1766217791987713#item-link-Steps%20for%20creating%20Standard%20Carousel%20Ads).
| | Standard call-to-action | Specified.
The recommended call-to-action is “Call now”. | `call_to_action` | Pass a valid value.
The recommended value is `CALL_NOW`. | | Dynamic call-to-action | Not supported | `call_to_action_id` | Not supported | | Interactive add-on | Not supported | `card_id` | Not supported | | Destination | Any of the following options:
  • Phone number
  • TikTok Instant Page
| `phone_region_code`
`phone_region_calling_code`
`phone_number`
`page_id` |
  • To specify Destination as phone number, you need to pass in `phone_region_code`, `phone_region_calling_code`, and `phone_number`.

    Note: To obtain the region code (`phone_region_code`) and region calling code (`phone_region_calling_code`) for the region of a specific phone number, use [/tool/phone_region_code/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1774488637039618).

  • To specify Destination as TikTok Instant Page, set `page_id` to the ID of a Custom TikTok Instant Page.
| | Smart Creative | Not supported | `is_smart_creative`
(in [/ad/aco/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739473063234626)) | Not supported | ``` ### Example Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/ad/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "adgroup_id": "{{adgroup_id}}", "creatives": [{ "ad_name": "{{ad_name}}", "identity_type":"CUSTOMIZED_USER", "identity_id":"{{identity_id}}", "ad_format": "SINGLE_VIDEO", "video_id":"{{video_id}}", "image_ids":["{{image_id}}"], "ad_text": "{{ad_text}}", "call_to_action": "CALL_NOW", "phone_region_code":"US", "phone_region_calling_code":"+1", "phone_number":"{{phone_number}}" }] }' (/code) ``` seo_title: Create TikTok Lead Generation ads optimizing phone calls
seo_description: Find out the detailed steps for creating a Manual Lead Generation ad that drives phone calls. Read the guide to help you get the task done right.
